n: Event <Trials for Navigator> is now open

missions: Complete Orientation Trial: TN-1 with 1 or more Operator with the [Nuker] tag in the squad (except fixed squad)
Complete Orientation Trial: TN-2 and defeat 20 aerial units with Laterano Operators
Complete Orientation Trial: TN-3 and defeat 1 leader enemy with a Victoria Operator
Deploy a total of 40 Operators in event stages
Use a total of 50 skills in event stages
Defeat a total of 100 enemies in event stages
Activate [Repair Kit] and complete any Spectacular Trial with 5 or more Defender or Medic Operators in squad
Activate [Maintenance Patch] and complete any Spectacular Trial while a total of 10 or Operators moved to the next wave without retreating
Activate [Reduction Module] and complete any Spectacular Trial with 6 or more Operators of different classes
Activate [Optimize Load] and complete any Spectacular Trial with 1 or more Operator who was deployed in all waves

list: Unlock limiter units [Maintenance Patch], [Reduction Module] and [Optimize Load].

A medal personally crafted by the developer of 'Trials for Navigator,' Closure.
No matter what kind of trials you will face, she will always be on your side.
Complete the Spectacular Trial of TN-4 Proud Sun's Shadow.

A medal made in the image of a navigator pulling an all-nighter in the offices of Rhodes Island.
The contents of the trials are everchanging, and your unmovable persistence fills all around you with great admiration.
